tennogamenolife.race.flugel.description: One of the sixteen races of Disboard, the Flügel were created by Artosh, the Old Deus of War. Their wings mark their celestial origin, while immense magical power and an instinct for battle reflect their purpose. Though shaped as weapons in the ancient war, each Flügel can pursue knowledge, rivalry, and purpose beyond combat.

tennogamenolife.race.machine.description: An artificial race of Disboard, the Ex-Machina are built for war yet capable of thought, memory, and bonds beyond their original directives. They process information with extraordinary speed, coordinate through shared networks, and adapt to opponents through analysis. Their mechanical bodies are formidable, but individuality can emerge when experience challenges the logic of the collective.

tennogamenolife.race.lesser_dragonia.des: A young Dragonia from Disboard, distinct from the True Dragons of the Cardinal World. Lesser Dragonias possess formidable strength, natural resistance to magic, and growing stores of magicules, but have yet to reach the heights of their evolved kin. Growth and hardship may awaken greater power and unlock new stages of draconic evolution.

tennogamenolife.race.dwarf.description: Dwarves of Disboard lack the innate ability to use magic directly, but they compensate with ingenuity and craftsmanship. Skilled smiths and engineers, they build sophisticated magical machinery that lets them shape the battlefield and create tools beyond their natural power. Their craft turns careful planning into strength, even in a world ruled by magic.
